release_notes:
• Downloads and update checks now come from nexussr.org instead of a third-party page.
  • Meta-analysis: corrected effect-size arithmetic, studies are no longer dropped in silence, and the engine now has a test suite.
  • Citations: references keep volume and page numbers, and Claim-to-Citation matches claims far more accurately.
  • Reader: reading queues, annotations and highlights that survive closing the PDF.
  • Agreement: a real 95% confidence interval for Cohen's kappa, and studies nobody compared are no longer scored.
  • Risk of Bias: corrected ROBINS-I and JBI items, and the AI pre-fill can no longer invent an answer the tool does not offer.
  • Search String Creator and Polyglot: the query searches what you asked for, and nothing is dropped without telling you.
  • Reference set check: measure how much of a known set your search actually recovered, and why a paper is missing.
  • Library: duplicate pairing by title works again on .nbib, .csv and .xml imports.
  • AI: cheaper calls, a spending ceiling, and the same results parser for every route.
